This repository contains the lab materials for [IM952: Big Data Research: Hype or Revolution?](https://warwick.ac.uk/fac/cross_fac/cim/apply-to-study/cross-disciplinary-postgraduate-modules/qs906-big-data-hype-or-revolution/), taught at the [Centre for Interdisciplinary Methodologies](https://warwick.ac.uk/fac/cross_fac/cim/) at the University of Warwick.

In the next three lab sessions, we will be replicating an ongoing research project that uses a data-centric approach to interrogate about considerations of data production and EDI. There are three main learning outcomes:

- Gain technical skills to work with and interrogate datasets to address real research questions

- Gain critical skills to interrogate and work with dataset

- Gain research skills by familiarising with data-centric research projects and learning how to interrogate data to address research questions
